about: Experience Gravity Crash™ Portable originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Retro fun meets futuristic thrills in space shooter Gravity Crash Portable. Blast aliens across 30 hostile planets in stellar missions filled to the brim with wormholes, laser beams and amazing explosions. The battle for the stars has begun – download Gravity Crash Portable today and prepare for lift-off.

This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Battle for the stars as you control a space fighter to survive each mission!
